summary.text: Gene Andersen is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican John Hunt.

paragraphs.text: Andersen advanced from the Democratic primary for Cheshire 14 on September 8, 2026.
He was also a Democratic candidate in 2020 for the two-seat Cheshire 11 district, where incumbent John Hunt and Jim Qualey defeated him and Patricia Martin in the general election.
